headline: MoonMath AI Open-Sources a HIP Attention Kernel for AMD MI300X That Beats AITER v3 on Every Shape and Rounding Mode
context: The HIP kernel uses one-instruction asm wrappers and an eight-wave pipeline to outperform AMD's AITER v3 on MI300X. The post MoonMath AI Open-Sources a HIP Attention Kernel for AMD MI300X That Beats AITER v3 on Every Shape and Rounding Mode appeared first on MarkTechPost .
